investigation: PSI-107, SPICE: laminar gas-jet diffusion flames in coflowing air in the Microgravity Science Glovebox
description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_spice_w0.md, section 7: smoke point of a microgravity jet flame in coflow. Derived case inputs (SI conversions of nozzle_id_mm and u_air_cm_s, fuel indicators, fuel_mass_flow) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.

features.name: nozzle_diameter
features.description: inner diameter of the fuel nozzle

features.name: fuel_mass_flow
features.description: mass flow of all gas through the nozzle; the two smoke-point targets give it weight zero

features.name: x_fuel
features.description: fuel mole fraction of the nozzle gas (balance nitrogen)

targets.name: smoke_point_length
targets.description: luminous length, nozzle to tip on the axis, at incipient soot emission (lane-local)

targets.name: smoke_point_fuel_flow
targets.description: nozzle gas mass flow at the smoke point

targets.name: flame_length
targets.description: luminous length of the flame at a setting (lane-local)

targets.name: emits_soot
targets.description: at this setting soot leaves the tip (at or past the smoke point)
